description:
Defines a Plan B store used to hold trace logs, i.e. the spans that make up each trace as it passes between services.
Spans are grouped into their traces as they arrive, and the traces are kept so that they can be queried and analysed by a Pathways document.

Data is loaded into the store using the PlanBFilter pipeline element.
groupDescription: Documents relating to the process of adding data into an index, such as Lucene or Elasticsearch.
